Optimal.Notes: A 40 Hz refresh rate with a matching frame cap gives the smoothest pacing on the OLED panel without demanding full 60 fps performance; FSR from 1024x640 recovers image quality well. Drop Texture Quality to Low if VRAM pressure causes stutters.
